description: Run It Again / One Branch Forks. Image 2: a low view from a Queensland veranda.
detail: Run It Again / One Branch Forks. Image 2: a low view from a Queensland veranda. · GumView(blueTip twigDepth). Use blueTip=1 for the drawn fork; 0 grows a leafed fork. · TwigDepth 0, 1 or 2 controls successive fork generations on every foliage spray. · Main boughs keep their traced silhouettes. The editor seed varies leaves and spray angles. · Approximate metres, Y up. Reproduce the preview from (0, 0.92, 4.4), facing -Z · with 12 degrees of upward pitch, 54.2 degrees horizontal field of view, 16:9. · Heights, hidden surfaces and out-of-frame limbs are inferred from a single view. · Each shoot forks into two shorter shoots. Each leaf attaches at its own shoot station. · The spine bends down quadratically, and a small out-of-plane bend gives it depth.
